grouping.blurb: Drag one map instrument onto another to dock them into a shared card. Drag a member back out to free it, or scale the whole group at once.

mapSplit.blurb: The Split button on the map shares the panel with Vision. Drag the divider to set the size; the Pilot layout starts this way with synthetic vision.
mapSplit.title: Map and vision side by side

workspaceLayouts.blurb: The Workspace button switches between Pilot, FPV and Mission, each with its own panels, cockpit instruments and split. Save your own and share them as a file.
